name: Transit Depot
description: A pre-war bus terminal taken over by the Scavengers Union as a trading post. Neutral ground, technically — but the Union charges heavily for the privilege.

interactables.label: Union Contract Board
interactables.text: Job postings in the Scavengers Union style: blunt, numbered, no names. #17: 'Silo run. Iron Covenant presence confirmed. Rate negotiable. Ask Rex.' The posting is weeks old.

ambient_description: The smell of diesel and old plastic. Traders arguing over exchange rates. A radio crackling somewhere — the signal again, barely audible.
